summary.one_liner: kobs is an application-centric Kubernetes and cloud observability platform, built on Custom Resource Definitions, that brings metrics, logs, traces and Kubernetes resources into one place.
summary.what_it_does: kobs provides a web-based view of Kubernetes workloads across multiple clusters, covering common resources such as Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and Pods, plus all Custom Resource Definitions. Users can edit and delete resources, scale Deployments and StatefulSets, view CPU and memory usage, read Pod logs, and exec into Pods. It integrates Prometheus, Elasticsearch (logs), Jaeger (traces), and Kiali for Istio service mesh topology. Custom Resources let teams group applications, teams and users, and build topology dashboards showing how applications connect. Access is managed via OIDC and Teams and Users custom resources, and the platform can be extended with plugins.
use_cases: monitor Kubernetes applications across multiple clusters
view pod logs and exec into containers
view Prometheus metrics next to Kubernetes resources
map application topology and service mesh connections
manage access to cluster tools with OIDC and team permissions
notable: Application-centric model built on Custom Resource Definitions for describing and grouping apps across clusters
Combines metrics, logs, traces and Kubernetes resources in one interface
Plugin system for customization and developer-experience add-ons
Teams and Users custom resources drive permissions
caveats: The README says klogs, a related component, is deprecated and no longer receives updates
The README suggests Grafana Kubernetes and Backstage plugins as alternatives for similar functionality
No installation or run instructions are given in the README
